egm96_15m.i16.source: NGA EGM96 via GeographicLib egm96-15 (public domain)

etopo_15m.i16.source: NOAA ETOPO1 (etopo180, ERDDAP) subsampled every 15 arc-min

dem_alps_512.i16.what: Terrain height above mean sea level, metres, around Mont Blanc (Alps)
dem_alps_512.i16.layout: row-major; row 0 = north edge, col 0 = west edge; rows go south, cols go east
dem_alps_512.i16.registration: area: value [row][col] is the mean height of the 90 m cell with centre E = xmin + (col + 0.5) * 90, N = ymax - (row + 0.5) * 90
dem_alps_512.i16.grid_north: grid north is UTM north; true north is 1.53 degrees east of grid north at the centre (meridian convergence -1.53 degrees)
dem_alps_512.i16.source: AWS Terrain Tiles, Terrarium encoding (height = R * 256 + G + B / 256 - 32768), zoom 12, mostly SRTM and EU-DEM; each cell is the mean of 3 x 3 bilinear samples; built by dev/make_dem.mjs
